static_traits.name: Lin Kai
static_traits.family_status: Lives with parents and two younger siblings
static_traits.social_status: 有一支支持性的训练伙伴与教练团队，但近期因缺乏动力与负面自我评价与训练伙伴Relationship tension
static_traits.medical_history: deny以往类似心理问题；without既往心理治疗；without明显重大躯体疾病
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰，逻辑性较好，语速平稳，配合度较高；但倾向消极评估与“全或without”式表述，常用Self-denial语句

basic_info.main_problem: 在与一位竞争对手的短跑比赛失利后，我觉得自己是个糟糕的跑者，这导致了失败感与without能感的持续出现。
basic_info.core_demands: 我决定寻求咨询，因为我意识到关于跑步能力的消极想法正在影响我的竞技表现和心理健康。我想重新享受跑步，not再一直感觉自己是个失败者。
growth_experiences: 过往有几个赛季表现Good，获得教练与队友的积极反馈，一直高度重视自己的跑步能力与成绩，并将其视为重要的自我评价来源。
上个月在一次短跑比赛中失利，强烈打击了自信，此后每当想到跑步或训练便产生失败与without能感，逐步影响日常作息、人际互动与竞技表现。

core_beliefs: 我的价值取决于我的比赛成绩
I am not good enough / I am a failure

special_situations.event: 上月与竞争对手的短跑比赛失利
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果在关键比赛中have not获胜，就证明我是个糟糕的跑者
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 加大训练强度并设定not切实际的目标来弥补失败
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我很糟糕/我是个糟糕的跑者

special_situations.event: 临出门准备去跑步或训练的时刻
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我现在训练也not会改变结果，失败是必然的
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids or delays training, reducing engagement to escape feelings of failure
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: without论我做什么都not会有变化，我又要失败了

special_situations.event: 观看他人训练并取得进步时
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果do not人在进步而我have not，就说明我not如人、我应该更好才对
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Self-blame, comparing with others, reduced communication with partners
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我应该更好，但我就是not行，I am a failure

special_situations.event: When recalling past successful seasons or others mention previous results
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 过去的成功not代表现在，如果现在not能赢，那些都not算数
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: negate正面证据，将成功归因为运气以维持负面自我图式
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 过去的成绩not真实，那只是运气

core_conflict.wish: Longs to prove self-worth through stable good grades and gain others' recognition and respect
core_conflict.fear: 害怕失败后被视为without能、失去自尊与他人的看重
defense_goal: 以自我苛责和全或without标准逼迫自己维持高水平以避免失败
在情绪高涨时回避训练来暂时降低Anxiety与羞耻感

object_relations.self_representation: 失败的、能力not足的跑者，自我价值脆弱
object_relations.object_representation: 苛刻的评判者/not断进步并可能超越自己的他人（队友、竞争者、潜在的批评者）

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor invites one to look for counter-evidence or recall past successes
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将过去的成功体验视为与当下without关、像“另一个人”的事，not易连接到当下自我
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 语气冷静疏离，use“那像是另一个人/not真实”的表达，淡化与积极情绪的连接。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor affirms one's ability and encourages adopting a more balanced explanation
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将过去的成绩归因为运气，以削弱积极证据对当前Self-denial的威胁
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use“运气/偶然”等字眼解释正面事实，继续强调当前失败以维持原有叙事。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor proposes gradual progress and setting feasible small goals
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 倾向以逻辑推演negate改变的可能，回避接触相关情绪与脆弱
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 保持克制与保留的语气，强调“not确定是否有效/可能not会改变感受”，弱化情感层面的探讨。

manifestations: 赛后常产生“有什么意义”的体验，认为努力not会改变结果
Expectation for training and competitions declines, hard to connect to past senses of achievement
虽有训练伙伴与教练支持，但not yet向他们表达失败与without能感
与训练伙伴Relationship tension、减少交流

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: 在会谈中频繁use“应该”“必须”自我评判（如“我应该更好”）
Treats winning and losing as the only value standard, finding it hard to accept grayness and process

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to perform some action toward other people or things, and does it to themselves instead, aiming the energy at themselves.
manifestations: not向伙伴与教练表达感受，将失望与挫败转为自责
When under stress, reduces training engagement, turning energy that could have gone to external communication and seeking support into harsh self-blame

contact_model.definition: 个体过度的自我Reflection与自我苛责，对接触过于小心谨慎，与“自主性”对应。
manifestations: 反复Self-denial（“我是个糟糕的跑者”），难以接纳正面反馈
Remains skeptical of positive evidence in session and quickly dismisses it

positive_force: 既往多个赛季表现Good，教练评价其具备潜力与天赋
Has supportive training partners and a coaching team
Values running and is willing to proactively seek help (starting counseling)
Able in session to try proposing more balanced alternative statements
negative_force: 将自我价值过度绑定于竞技成绩
灾难化、全或without、过度概括及negate积极证据等认知模式固化
Under pressure, avoids or reduces training investment to escape failure and shame
not与支持系统沟通导致支持资源not yet被动员
频繁自责与社会比较引发Decreased motivation与Impaired self-esteem

target_behavior.behavior: Training motivation drops markedly and avoidance of training/matches appears
antecedent: 临近训练或出门跑步前
观看他人训练与进步时
target_behavior.core_reason: 将一次失败泛化为整体能力not足，采用全或without标准评价自我，并灾难化预测再次失败以避免羞耻
target_behavior.function: 逃避Anticipation的失败与羞耻，短期降低Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: 竞技表现持续下滑，训练伙伴Relationship tension，Impaired self-esteem，日常活动受影响

target_behavior.behavior: Negative self-talk and self-labeling (e.g., 'I am a terrible runner')
target_behavior.core_reason: 自我价值与成绩过度绑定，negate积极证据以维持负面自我图式
target_behavior.function: 通过自我惩罚式评估维持控制与高标准的幻觉，避免面对脆弱与not确定
target_behavior.consequence: 失败感与without力感加剧，动机与专注度下降，进一步影响训练与比赛表现
